name: agent-two-pass-blur
prompt: Effect: a two-pass separable box blur (horizontal then vertical) with a radius slider.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

definition.label: Box Blur

summary: I wrote the Box Blur effect (`gen.box-blur`, group Blur & Sharpen) but haven't run validate_effect, compiled the GLSL or rendered it, because no Powermove tools were attached to this run. It uses two passes: `u_pass` 0 blurs horizontally and pass 1 blurs vertically. It has one keyframeable control, Radius (0–64 px, default 8); fractional values partly weight the outer pixels so the radius animates smoothly, and it averages premultiplied RGBA so transparent edges stay clean.
